species.tagline: The commonest fish of the Shing Mun River mouth

tasks.title: Look at its shape
tasks.message: A mullet is smooth and streamlined, so it swims fast without tiring.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a grey mullet. Its smooth body slips through the water quickly.

tasks.title: Where it lives
tasks.message: Where the river meets the sea — brackish water — is its favourite place.
tasks.subtitle: Mullet love where fresh water meets salt water. The Shing Mun River mouth is full of them.

tasks.title: How to help
tasks.hint: Remember: no litter in the river
tasks.message: Clean water is the only place a mullet can live.
tasks.subtitle: Keeping litter out of the river gives the fish somewhere to live. Thank you!
